what: Matched A/B of three atlas beam ideas on top of BEAM_P2=2 in research/acc/optimality/acc_beam.c: BEAM_QUOTA=q (B16/B17, at most q survivors per cyclic-class pair), BEAM_WH=1 (B83, Whitehead-minimal cyclic total as the key after P2), and the beam-loss diagnostic (B20 + Plate XI, BEAM_TRACE_FILE + beam_loss.py)

settings.arm_note: P2=3 and P2=3+Q16 were added at the lead's request after the first four arms (score zoo, SCORE_ZOO.md); they ran on acc_beam_x v2 (P2=3 added), which is stdout-identical to v1 on the v1 flags (validation.identity_v2_vs_v1). The elite arms (the lead's second request, BEAM_ELITE=W/4 with QUOTA=16) ran on v3 (BEAM_ELITE added), stdout-identical to v2 on the v2 flags (validation.identity_v3_vs_v2). Raw AC / Stable AC paths of every arm and row are in table[].<arm>.ac_path / sac_path
settings.scheduling: one beam at a time, nice -n 5, 20-minute cap (kill by PID); 3 other P2 search lanes on the other cores

definitions.QUOTA: class = unordered pair of cyclic conjugacy classes of (r0, r1), each up to inversion (64-bit hash of the least rotation of the cyclically reduced word or its inverse). Candidates admitted in key order while their class has < q; BEAM_DIV keeps its best 0.8W of the admitted list and samples the other 0.2W evenly from the admitted tail; if fewer than W are admitted, the rest are filled from the over-quota candidates in key order.
definitions.WH: greedy steepest descent over x->x y^e, x->y^e x, y->y x^e, y->x^e y (e=+-1) on both cyclic words until no automorphism lowers the cyclic total; key = P2 | WH | hprio | fingerprint bits (P1m slot of mode 2). Computed for multiplication children with a class-keyed cache, inherited for conjugation/inversion children.
definitions.P2=3: key = P2 (9 bits) | comm_len (10) | P1m (10) | hprio klen (18) | 17 fingerprint bits; comm_len = cyclically reduced length of r0 r1 r0^-1 r1^-1 on the stored words, computed for every child (0 mismatches vs score_zoo.py f_comm_len on 900 random-walk states)
definitions.ELITE: BEAM_ELITE=e with BEAM_QUOTA=q: the best e candidates by the full key are admitted regardless of class and do not use up their class quota; the other admissions obey the per-class quota q; BEAM_DIV then works on the admitted list as for QUOTA.
definitions.TRACE: BEAM_TRACE_FILE lines "i h1 h2" (fp() of the known path states); each depth prints rank, tie block (same key without fingerprint bits), cut keys at k1=0.8W and W, kept flag. Observation only.

validation.class_and_WH_invariance: 12,000 random conjugation/inversion/relator-swap walks from random-walk states of ac-05558, ac-00145, ac-06045 each (36,000 total): 0 class mismatches, 0 WH mismatches; the class changes on 400/400 multiplication children per row
validation.WH_vs_independent_python: 200 random-walk states (ac-06045): 0 mismatches against an independent string implementation of the same descent; mean WH drop below the cyclic total 0.385 letters, max 18
validation.trace_fingerprint_port: beam_loss.py refuses to analyse unless the beam reports the start state as trace index 0 (Python fp() port = acc_opt.c fp()); held on every diagnostic run
validation.official_verifier: every AC and Stable AC path from every A/B arm replayed with the SAIR verifier (competition/tools/verifier, manifest data)

kill_condition: fixed before the runs: QUOTA / WH are dead if they never beat P2=2 on any row (AC or Stable AC length) and never find a path where P2=2 finds none

verdicts.QUOTA q=4: dead: worse than P2=2 on 6 rows, same on 1 (ac-00145, all none); no path P2 misses
verdicts.QUOTA q=16: alive by the fixed rule only through sac-00487 27 (P2=2 28), a live-record tie we did not hold; worse on 5 rows, same on 1
verdicts.WH: dead: never better than P2=2 (worse on ac-07435, ac-06045; same on 5)
verdicts.P2=3 (comm_len): dead as a beam key: never better than P2=2 (worse on ac-06045 44 vs 39 and ac-04211 none vs 33; same on 5); the offline top-3 gain did not transfer
verdicts.P2=3+Q16: dead: worse than P2=2 on 6 rows; the comm_len tie-break plus quota drifts to long states (len up to 1,300-2,100 at d=30)
verdicts.ELITE e=W/4 + QUOTA 16 under P2=2: best arm: never worse than P2=2 on any row or field; better on ac-00487 (AC 26 vs 27 = live record, SAC 27 vs 28 = live record) and ac-06045 (SAC 41 vs 42)
verdicts.ELITE + QUOTA 16 under P2=3: mixed: better on ac-00487 (26/27) and ac-07435 (AC 26 = record vs 28), worse on ac-04211, ac-05558, ac-06045 (AC), ac-04346 (SAC)
